content:

title: Eurostat: EU trade in wind turbines increased in 2025
content:
EU-produced wind turbines had an export value of €3.1 billion in 2025, relative to imports of €0.7 billion.
Compared with the previous year, exports increased both in value (10.8%) and volume (9.5%).
